simple.meaning: עָבוּר (ʻâbûwr) is a Hebrew object word meaning “passed , i.e. kept over ; used only of stored grain.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Joshua 5:11. The surrounding context includes land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָבוּר (H5669) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
